title: Port Alder Rising
author: Bram Kavanagh
blurb: Marguerite Eastwick, a marine biologist counting turtles instead of heartbreaks, has spent three years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. Then the anonymous pen-pal assignment pairs enemies instead of strangers — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must choose between the career that saved everything and the person who sees clearly at last, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
